# External and reference test data

`testdata/` contains non-Firmament inputs: imported STEP corpora, external/reference models, manifests that belong to imported formats, and deliberate golden exports. Preserve third-party provenance and notices with imported data.

Firmament-family authored test documents (`.firmament`, `.firmfixture`, and `.firmasm`) belong under [`fixtures/`](../fixtures/README.md). A new external STEP corpus belongs under the appropriate `testdata/step*/` provenance subtree.
